# restate_deployment (Data Source)

A registered deployment, looked up by ID.

Unlike the resource, this exposes both endpoint kinds' attributes as a flat set: the ones belonging to the other kind are null. Check `endpoint_type` before reading them.

`additional_headers` is deliberately **not** exposed. Header values are typically credentials, and there is no configured value to reconcile a redacted or omitted one against, so publishing them would be misleading at best.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a deployment registered outside this configuration.
#
# Both endpoint kinds' attributes are exposed as a flat set; the ones belonging to the other kind are
# null, so check `endpoint_type` first. `additional_headers` is deliberately not exposed: header
# values are typically credentials and there is nothing to reconcile a redacted one against.

data "restate_deployment" "orders" {
  id = "dp_1a2b3c"
}

output "endpoint" {
  value = data.restate_deployment.orders.endpoint_type == "http" ? data.restate_deployment.orders.uri : data.restate_deployment.orders.arn
}

output "sdk_version" {
  value = data.restate_deployment.orders.sdk_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Deployment ID to look up, for example `dp_1a2b3c`.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Lambda function ARN. Null for an HTTP deployment.
- `assume_role_arn` (String) Role Restate assumes when invoking the function. Null when unset or for an HTTP deployment.
- `compression` (String) Negotiated Lambda response compression. Null when none or for an HTTP deployment.
- `created_at` (String) When the deployment was registered.
- `endpoint_type` (String) Which endpoint kind this deployment is: `http` or `lambda`.
- `http_version` (String) Negotiated HTTP version. Null for a Lambda deployment.
- `max_protocol_version` (Number) Highest service protocol version the SDK supports.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Deployment metadata.
- `min_protocol_version` (Number) Lowest service protocol version the SDK supports.
- `protocol_type` (String) Service protocol mode. Null for a Lambda deployment.
- `sdk_version` (String) SDK version reported during discovery.
- `services` (Attributes List) Services this deployment exposes, as discovered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
- `uri` (String) HTTP endpoint URI. Null for a Lambda deployment.

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Service name.
- `revision` (Number) Service revision.
